ja: • 新幹線500系「こだま」がV編成仕様でリニューアル登場。
• ５号車（525形7000番台）の側面・窓ガラスと３号車用屋根板が付属。
• 別売りのAセットに付属する４号車（528形7000番台）の屋根板を仕様することで５号車（525形7000番台）を組み立てることが可能。
• ３号車は５号車用の側面を代用して組み立てることができる。
• ７号車は既発売の「のぞみ」編成の11号車（527形700番台）としても利用可能。
・動力ユニット3対応・走行台車T対応・2両入り
en: • Shinkansen 500 series "Kodama" has been renewed with V formation specification.
• A 2-car set of car No. 8 (522 type 7000 series) and car No. 7 (527 type 7700 series).
• Side and window glass of car No. 5 (525 type 7000 series) and roof plate for car No. 3 are included.
• It is possible to assemble car No. 5 (525 type 7000 series) by using the roof plate of car No. 4 (528 type 7000 series) that comes with the A set (sold separately).
• Car No. 3 can be assembled by substituting the side for car No. 5.
• Car No. 7 can also be used as car No. 11 (527 type 700 series) of the already released "Nozomi" formation.
・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
